classData.comment:
/**
     * @summary Applies the documented final offset while preserving alignment metadata.
     *
     * `moveBy()` is intentionally immutable and its clone carries geometric minima only. Alignment
     * consumers also need the resolved zone/position, so the finishing step transfers those two
     * semantic fields onto the moved clone. Every successful `alignTo()` return passes through this
     * helper; otherwise constrained and overlap returns silently skip the same public option.
     * @param {Rectangle} result
     * @param {Number[]|undefined} offset
     * @returns {Rectangle}
     */
classData.summary:
Applies the documented final offset while preserving alignment metadata.

`moveBy()` is intentionally immutable and its clone carries geometric minima only. Alignment
consumers also need the resolved zone/position, so the finishing step transfers those two
semantic fields onto the moved clone. Every successful `alignTo()` return passes through this
helper; otherwise constrained and overlap returns silently skip the same public option.

/**
     * Returns the area this Rectangle shares with the other one.
     *
     * A zero-size `other` has no area to share, so it returns `false`, the same as a disjoint one.
     * Rectangles that only touch along an edge do not overlap either.
     * To test whether a point lies inside this Rectangle, use {@link #containsPoint}.
     * @param {DOMRect|Neo.util.Rectangle|Object} other An object with x, y, width and height
     * @returns {Neo.util.Rectangle|Boolean} The overlapping area as a new Rectangle, or `false` if there is none
     */
classData.description:
Returns the area this Rectangle shares with the other one.

A zero-size other has no area to share, so it returns false, the same as a disjoint one. Rectangles that only touch along an edge do not overlap either. To test whether a point lies inside this Rectangle, use {@link #containsPoint}.

params.description: An object with x, y, width and height
params.name: other

returns.description: The overlapping area as a new Rectangle, or `false` if there is none

classData.comment:
/**
     * @summary Returns a copy of this Rectangle inside the bounds: moved by the smallest distance, and shrunk only on
     * an axis it cannot fit on, never below its `minWidth` and `minHeight`. A minimum larger than the bounds keeps the
     * leading edge inside, as {@link #alignTo} does when no side fits. A Rectangle inside the bounds comes back as it is.
     * @param {DOMRect|Neo.util.Rectangle} bounds
     * @returns {Neo.util.Rectangle}
     */
classData.summary:
Returns a copy of this Rectangle inside the bounds: moved by the smallest distance, and shrunk only on
an axis it cannot fit on, never below its `minWidth` and `minHeight`. A minimum larger than the bounds keeps the
leading edge inside, as {@link #alignTo} does when no side fits. A Rectangle inside the bounds comes back as it is.
classData.name: fitTo

classData.comment:
/**
     * @summary Returns an immutable Rectangle aligned to a target, optionally constrained and offset.
     * If no side fits at the usual size, use the side with the largest usable area and shrink to
     * its bounds. If the declared minima rule out every side, keep the leading edges reachable
     * in the overall constraint. The final offset applies after placement.
     * @param {Object} align
     * @param {Boolean|String} [align.axisLock]
     * @param {DOMRect|HTMLElement|Rectangle|String} [align.constrainTo]
     * @param {String} align.edgeAlign
     * @param {Boolean} [align.matchSize]
     * @param {Number[]} [align.offset] Final `[x, y]` vector applied after alignment/constraint.
     * @param {DOMRect|HTMLElement|Rectangle|String} align.target
     * @param {Number|Number[]} [align.targetMargin]
     * @returns {Rectangle}
     */
classData.summary:
Returns an immutable Rectangle aligned to a target, optionally constrained and offset.
If no side fits at the usual size, use the side with the largest usable area and shrink to
its bounds. If the declared minima rule out every side, keep the leading edges reachable
in the overall constraint. The final offset applies after placement.
classData.name: alignTo
